features.title: Sensory crest
features.description: Hair cells and supporting cells occupy a raised epithelial region in the ampulla. A receptor cell and its afferent neuron remain distinct.

features.title: Cupula
features.description: Bundles interact with an overlying cupula. The cupula reaches the simplified ampullary roof; it is not drawn with an otoconial crystal layer.

features.title: Mechanical context
features.description: Relative fluid/duct motion and cupular displacement depend on the time course of rotation. The drawing does not simulate those dynamics.

features.title: Sensory patch
features.description: Hair cells and supporting cells form a local sensory patch. The drawing does not map the polarity reversal across an entire macula.

features.title: Otoconial load
features.description: The diagram shows otoconia associated with an otolithic membrane. This arrangement differs from the normal crista cupula.

features.title: Mechanical context
features.description: Gravity and translational acceleration contribute to loading in head-fixed coordinates. Bundle polarity and population organisation still matter.
